Kageaki"Captain."
Kanae"Ah... Kageaki... So you have come after all... for me..."
Sayo"Madam... so much devotion, all aimed at one person... heaven must finally have received the message, no...?"
Kanae"Yes... This much at least I have been granted... to see you like this, at the very end..."
Kageaki"Captain, what is this fainthearted talk?"
Kageaki"May I sit here?"
Sayo"Please, please. You must have a cushion; I shall bring it."
Kageaki"Do not trouble yourself."
Kanae"Hehe... Surely I may be allowed to know my own body, Kageaki... Who else will know it better?... And you also, in your heart, are quite aware... are you not...?"
Kageaki"Yes..."
Sayo"My poor madam..."
Sayo"And with the tea, Minato sir... tempura-fried manju buns will be acceptable...?"

en.html:
Kageaki"...Tempura?"
Kanae"For my remaining life... there is very little time left now, Kageaki............"
Kageaki"You are joking."
Sayo"Full tradition behind it. Aizu’s own specialty."
Kageaki"...Not the challenging new product of a sweet-maker whose courage has escaped supervision?"
Sayo"Not yesterday’s foolishness, sir. It goes back to Lord Masayuki, first lord of the Aizu Matsudaira house."
Kanae"You are still allowing for a joke...? With a matter like this, would I have the heart to make one...?"
Kageaki"It is... not a joke?"
Sayo"Truth only, sir... It has merely come dressed as a joke..."
Kanae"Look at that tree in the garden, Kageaki."
Kageaki"A tree? ...That deciduous one? What about it?"
Kanae"You will agree... there is just the one leaf remaining...?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Sayo"More than three hundred years ago, in Shinshu, they say. Lord Masayuki was transferred from Takato to Aizu; the sweet came along with him—"
Kanae"...When that last leaf falls... surely I too shall die..."
Sayo"—And there you have it: exactly the same sweet is traditional in Shinshu also!"
Kageaki"Impossible—such a thing..."
Sayo"This world, sir. Lower your guard, and even the sweets get you."
Kanae"Of course, from your side it is difficult to believe... But from mine... there is no such uncertainty..."
Kanae"That one frail leaf... you are looking at my very life, Kageaki............"
Kageaki"...Ah."
Kanae"————"

ja.html:
景明「……天麩羅？」
香奈枝「わたくしの命が尽きるまで…… 　もう、幾許もありません…………」
景明「お戯れを」
さよ「伝統ある会津名物でございます」
景明「……冒険心旺盛な菓子屋のチャレンジング 新商品ではなく？」
さよ「会津松平家の初代、正之公まで遡る歴史が ございます」
香奈枝「冗談でこんなこと、言えるとお思い……？」
景明「冗談では……ないのですか？」
さよ「冗談のような真実でございまして……」
香奈枝「あの庭木をご覧になって、景明さま」
景明「木？ 　……あの落葉樹が、何か？」
香奈枝「葉が一枚、残っていますでしょう……？」
景明「はい」
さよ「三百年以上も昔に信州で考案され、高遠の 領主であった正之公の会津移封と共にこの地 へ伝えられたとか――」
香奈枝「……あの最後の葉が落ちた時…… 　きっと、わたくしも死ぬのです……」
さよ「――なので、信州にも全く同じ菓子が伝統 料理として伝わっているのです！」
景明「まさか――そのようなことが」
さよ「世の中はまこと、油断ならぬものでござい ます」
香奈枝「信じて頂けないのは当然ですけれど…… 　でも……わたくしにはわかる……」
香奈枝「あの弱々しい一枚の葉は…… 　わたくしの……命そのもの…………」
景明「……あっ」
香奈枝「――――」

en.html:
Kageaki"............"
Kanae"Ah... now at any moment... it may fall..."
Kageaki"May fall? But just now it actually—"
Sayo"Now, Minato sir. Please have one."
Kageaki"Thank you."
Kageaki"...Hmm. For taste, this has made a category of its own."
Sayo"Ho-ho-ho. No forcing yourself, sir. Take the help of the tea; for that purpose I have made it strong."
Kageaki"...No... If one gives the taste proper attention, it is rather—"
Kanae"Ah, Kageaki...! Now we have come to it... the time for parting..."
Kanae"For my last request... you will at least give me a hearing...?"
Kageaki"Captain, just now you went into the garden, put that leaf back, and came rushing in again. At lightning speed. Did you not?"
Kanae"Hehe... Such dreamlike things you are saying..."
Sayo"Minato sir, even encouragement is more than madam can bear now, extra manju are here, ah, God, why this cruelty to madam...!"
Kageaki"Thank you. It is only a question of getting the tongue accustomed. Quite good, actually..."
Kanae"Kageaki, please...! Before that manju... no, no, the leaf... You must hear my wish before it falls...!"

香奈枝「ああ……今にも落ちてしまいそう……」
景明「しまいそうというか今」
さよ「さ、湊斗さま。お召し上がりくださいませ」
景明「では頂きます」
景明「……うぅむ。 　何とも、独特な風味」
さよ「ほっほっほ。 　ご無理をなさらず、お茶を使って下さって 結構でございますよ。濃いめに淹れておきま したから」

香奈枝「ああ、景明さま……！ 　お別れの時が来てしまったのですね……」
香奈枝「最後のお願いを……聞いてください……」
景明「今、電光の如き速さで庭を飛び出して葉を 元通りにしてまた駆け戻って来られませんで したか？　大尉殿」

さよ「湊斗さま、最早今のお嬢さまはそのような 励ましの言葉さえ辛いのでございます、饅頭 のお代わりはこちらでございます、ああ神は 何ゆえお嬢さまにこのような仕打ちを……！」
景明「頂きます。 　舌が慣れてくると、なかなか旨い……」
香奈枝「どうか――景明さま……！ 　あの饅頭……いえあの葉が落ちてしまう前 に、わたくしの願いを……！」

Kageaki"............"
Kanae"Ah—any moment now! My life...!"
Kanae"My life!"
Kageaki"Falling does not appear to be anywhere in its plans."
Sayo"She used casein glue when putting it back. Short of a typhoon, that leaf is in permanent employment."
Kanae"Kageaki... Surely this much pity you can spare... for a woman reduced to such a state..."
Kageaki"Pity is hardly—"
Kanae"You need not go so far as loving me... I am making no such demand... Just a little kindness will do..."
Kanae"...Or is it that... in your heart, Kageaki... you do have love for me...?"
Kageaki"Love."
Kanae"That you do, after all... have some love for me..."
Kageaki"There is none."
Kanae"GHEBAFF!!"
Sayo"Ah. This time the leaf has fallen."
Kageaki"May I have another cup of tea?"
Sayo"Certainly."
Sayo"...Hm. A little too strong, perhaps?"
Kageaki"No, it is quite all right."
Kanae"————————"

en.html:
Kanae"Hah!?"
Kanae"Ah... Kageaki! For a woman in my condition... surely one last wish is not too much...!"
Sayo"Achha. Rewinding all the way to there."
Kageaki"Is there anything I can do for you, Captain?"
Kanae"There is... And for doing it, there is nobody but you... nobody..."
Kageaki"What would that be?"
Kanae"...Whatever it turns out to be... you must not laugh at me, all right...?"
Kageaki"Never."
Kanae"Dying, yes... but still a woman with some shame... To ask a gentleman for such a thing... ah, where to hide my face...?"
Sayo"Madam, you must gather courage now!"
Kanae"Yes! ...Kageaki!"
Kageaki"Yes."
Sayo"Hm. We are left with just two tempura manju. Minato sir, if you would be so good as to finish those also..."
Kageaki"Thank you."
Kanae"While there is still life in me...! We must not let that manju fall first...!"
Sayo"It has already fallen, madam."
Kageaki"No, it has not."

　この憐れな女の、最後の願いを……どうか
……！」さよ「そこまで巻き戻るのですな」景明「自分に何か、大尉殿の為にして差し上げら
れる事があるのでしょうか」香奈枝「あります……
　景明さまにしか……できないこと……」景明「それは、どのような」香奈枝「……どうか、聞いてもお笑いにならないで
ね……」景明「決して」香奈枝「今際の際とはいえ、女の身で……
　こんなことを殿方にお頼みするはしたなさ
は……ああっ、身が縮みます」さよ「お嬢さま――勇気を！」香奈枝「ええ！
　……景明さま！」景明「はい」さよ「む、テンプラ饅頭があと二個だけあまって
おりますな。
　湊斗さま、よろしかったら食べてしまって
くださいませ」景明「有難うございます」香奈枝「わたくしの命があるうちに……！
　あの饅頭が落ちる前に……！」さよ「もう落ちてますよお嬢さま」景明「いえ、落ちていません」

Kanae"Please, this much you must do...!"
Sayo"Oh? Just now, surely it did—"
Kageaki"What fell was—"
Kanae"For this final thing, Kageaki... it must be your own hands—"
Sayo"The manju—"
Kageaki"The leaf."
Kanae"Please stack these three ten-sen coins upright, one on top of the other."
Kageaki"Certainly."

en.html:
Kanae"YOU DID IT————————!?"
Sayo"ARRE BAAP RE—THAT IS SOMETHING!!"
Kageaki"I have had practice in this, you see."
Kanae"KYUN!? Why have you TRAINED for this!?"
Kageaki"My younger sister was very good at it. Naturally, I also got into competing with her."
Sayo"Tum dono—what is WRONG with you two siblings!?"
Kageaki"And my sister, for your information, can do ten."
Kanae"TEN!? Arre, kya chutiyapa hai—am I competing with your sister or the bloody Reserve Bank!? How am I supposed to WIN!?"
Sayo"First let us have a little calm, madam. We shall take tea."
Sayo"One leaf is also left, mind you."
Kanae"Yes... perhaps I shall..."

さよ「すげェーーーーーーーーーーーーッ!!」

さよ「葉っぱも一個あまっております」
香奈枝「ええ……頂こうかしら……」

I gave my honest opinion while watching Kanae wipe her face with a towel.
Off came the makeup. Beneath it, healthy colour, blood doing its work perfectly well.

Even lying in bed appeared to be no longer a necessary part of the business.

en.html:
Sayo had stepped out.

With just the two of us, the room felt rather empty. A guest room entirely; sickroom, not even in outline.
No medicine smell either.

Did that mean treatment had stopped being necessary by yesterday evening at the latest?
...Whatever the case, her recovery was not moving at an ordinary person’s speed.

ja.html:
さよ侍従は席を外している。

　二人になると漠たる感を否めない室内は丸きり客間
の様相であり、病室らしさは片鱗も見て取れなかった。
　薬臭すら嗅げない。

　それはつまり、遅くとも昨日の晩頃には香奈枝嬢に
対する治療行為の必要が消失していた事を意味しよう
か。
　……まず、驚くべき回復力だった。

en.html:
Kageaki"I knew it had missed the vital organs. Even so—"
Kanae"Perhaps it is being back where I was born. Not that I was pining for home all that much. Only, now I am back, I do feel that the water and air suit my body."
Kanae"And the food, very good."
Kageaki"I see. Yes, such things must count for a great deal."
Kanae"By tomorrow, I think I shall be moving as usual."
Kageaki"That is good news. Only, do not overtax yourself. ...At any rate, I am relieved."
Kageaki"When I heard no visitors were permitted, my heart nearly stopped its work."
Kanae"That was at my request. To show you a sick face and make you worry for nothing—I did not want that. But it seems my meaning did not travel properly..."
Kanae"Instead, unnecessary worry for you. I am very sorry, Kageaki."
Kageaki"...No, Captain. An apology is entirely unnecessary."
Kageaki"You were injured because I failed. If apologies are to be counted, the large outstanding balance is mine. But—"
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"But—"

ja.html:
景明「元々急所を外していたのは存じていました が、それにしても」
香奈枝「生まれ故郷に戻ったから、かもしれません。 　べつにそれほど郷愁を覚えていたわけでは ないのですけれど。戻ってみると、やっぱり 水や空気が体に合うのは感じます」
香奈枝「ごはんもおいしいですし」
景明「成程。 　確かに、そういった事は大きいでしょう」
香奈枝「明日にはもう元通り動けると思います」
景明「何よりですが、ご無理はなさらぬよう。 　……ともあれ安堵しました」
景明「面会謝絶と伺った折は肝を冷やしましたが」
香奈枝「あれは病み姿をお見せして無用のお気遣い をさせてはと、わたくしの方からお願いして そう計らってもらったのですけど……。 　うまく伝わらなかったみたいで」
香奈枝「いたずらに心配をお掛けしてしまいました。 　申し訳もありません、景明さま」
景明「……いえ。大尉。 　謝罪など、全く無用の事です」
景明「そもそも大尉殿の御怪我は自分の不覚から。 こちらこそ幾重にもお詫びせねばなるまいと 思っておりました。 　しかし」
香奈枝「……」
景明「しかし――」
